# Quiet Cycle 0.3.0

Python library for typed menstrual-event pipelines and exact, fixed-landmark
model development. No frontend. No human-trained weights or clinical accuracy
claim. Synthetic examples are for software testing only.

- [README and exact formulas](README.md)
- [Training, knowledge-time and calibration rules](docs/TRAINING.md)
- [Evidence review](docs/EVIDENCE_REVIEW.md)
- [Learned model card](docs/MODEL_CARD_MULTIFACTOR.md)
- [Input contracts](docs/CONTRACT.md)
- [Imports](docs/IMPORTS.md)
- [Actual test evidence](docs/TEST_REPORT.md)
- [Security and privacy](SECURITY.md)

Python: quietcycle.learning.MultiFactorPipeline.
CLI: quiet-cycle fit / forecast / evaluate.
A fitted artifact applies to its one explicit elapsed-day landmark. Nominal
intervals do not imply unconditional or individual coverage guarantees.
